title: Razer’s 11-port USB-C dock just got $50 cheaper
summary: Razer’s 11-port USB-C travel dock drops to $79.99 on Amazon, adding 4K HDMI, Ethernet, card slots, and 85W charging.
body: The Razer USB-C Dock 11-Port Travel Charging Station is down to $79.99 on Amazon right now, which cuts $50 off the $129.99 recommended retail price. That’s a 38% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s the kind of drop that makes a premium travel dock much easier to justify. See the deal at Amazon

title: Anker Prime 3-in-1 charger drops under $100 in Amazon deal
summary: This Anker Prime 3-in-1 MagSafe charger is $50 off, with 25W Qi2.2 charging and a travel-ready foldable design.
body: The Anker Prime 25W Qi2.2-Certified Palm-Sized 3-in-1 Foldable MagSafe Charger is built for Apple users who want one compact charger for an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods, and there’s a strong deal on it right now. It’s a palm-sized foldable charging station from Anker that packs travel-friendly design with premium charging features. See the deal at Amazon

title: Google Wallet is working on a new payment option for international travel
summary: Wallet may soon support Alipay Plus payments in Southeast Asia.
body: TL;DR Google Wallet appears to be readying support for QR-code-based Alipay Plus payments. Users will automatically see the option appear when Wallet detects they’re in supported regions. Right now, a Google support page only explicitly mentions operation with payment networks in Singapore. When you’re out exploring the world, the last thing you want to worry about is not being able to pay for things. And while we’re not there quite yet, services like Google Wallet already go a long way towards giving us a universal payment solution. Now we’re getting an early look at how that’s getting even better, as Wallet prepares to offer an all-new way to pay. You’re reading an Authority Insights story. title: Amazon cuts Lenovo’s 8-port USB-C Slim Travel Dock by 23%

body: Lenovo’s USB-C Slim Travel Dock is built for people who work on the go and want more ports without carrying a bulky hub. It’s a very thin, travel-friendly dock made for mobile setups, and there’s a solid deal on it right now on Amazon. See the deal at Amazon
